resources.string: You need the PC game files: the folder with Game.ini, or the .zip as you downloaded it. It is copied into this app; the original is not touched.
The file as you downloaded it
Game.ini not found. Choose the game folder (or a .zip that has it).
Taken from the game and its Readme. The author goes into the app\'s signature; type it if it is missing.
Pictures and music are read from the APK instead of being copied
The APK is put together with the ready-made engine, signed in the author\'s name and installed.
A new one will be created in %1$s\'s name
Pick juego.json and firma.jks (on the PC: RMXP-Android-Ports\\juegos\\<game>). Then it updates the APK you made on the PC.
To back it up or use it on the PC
Pick both files: juego.json and firma.jks.
Done! You can open the game from your apps.

This game is already installed with a different signature. Import the signature you made it with (the PC one) and create it again. If you don\'t have it, uninstall the game: your saves stay in the RPG Maker folder if you turned it on.
Android asks you to allow this app to install apps. Turn it on, come back and tap Create again.
Your RPG Maker XP, VX and VX Ace fangames, turned into Android apps right on your phone. No PC and no other app in between.
Choose the game: its .zip or folder
Check name, author, icon and signature
Create the app and install it
Uses the mkxp-z engine from RMXP-Android-Ports, the same as the PC tool. In testing: if something fails, report it on GitHub with the game\'s log.
